description: This PHP source file defines the LowOrderFee controller class for the OpenCart admin extension. It handles displaying and saving configuration settings for a 'Low Order Fee' total extension, including rendering the configuration form with breadcrumbs, loading language strings, tax classes, and processing form submissions to update settings.

classes.name: LowOrderFee
classes.description: This class manages the admin interface for the Low Order Fee total extension in OpenCart, providing functionality to display current configuration settings and handle saving updated settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the configuration form for the Low Order Fee extension, setting up breadcrumbs, loading language strings, configuration values, tax classes, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the configuration settings submitted via the form, including permission check, updating settings in the database, and returning JSON response.
